LESSON: KNITTING SKILLS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Production Techniques
Topic 4.1: Knitting Skills

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Knitting Skills. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Knitting Skills
2. Practise Knitting Skills at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Knitting Skills

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Knitting Skills
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Knitting Skills. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Knitting Skills at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Knitting Skills at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Knitting Skills
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Knitting Skills. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Knitting Skills using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Knitting Skills in the examples.
2. Explain Knitting Skills to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Knitting Skills.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Knitting Skills using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Knitting Skills important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Knitting Skills
2. Practise Knitting Skills at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Knitting Skills

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
